# Northern Ontario Travel

> > Your comprehensive guide to Northern Ontario's wilderness, Indigenous cultures, outdoor adventures, and iconic destinations across five distinct regions.

Northern Ontario Travel is a destination marketing resource covering outdoor recreation, cultural experiences, seasonal travel planning, and regional tourism across Northern Ontario. The site features guides to five major regions (Algoma Country, Sunset Country, Superior Country, Northeastern Ontario, and North Bay), Indigenous experiences, canoe heritage, and Group of Seven art history, with curated accommodations and dining recommendations.

## Key Topics

- Northern Ontario
- Outdoor activities
- Indigenous culture
- Lake Superior
- Winter activities
- Regional tourism
- Canoe culture
- Northern lights
- Group of Seven
- Fishing
- Snowmobiling
- Adventure travel
- Seasonal planning
- First Nations tourism
- Wilderness experiences

## Regional Destinations

- [Algoma Country](https://northernontario.travel/algoma-country): Algoma Country regional guide: Lake Superior, winter activities.
- [Sunset Country](https://northernontario.travel/sunset-country): Sunset Country regional guide: fishing, northern lights, Lake of Woods.
- [Superior Country](https://northernontario.travel/superior-country): Superior Country guide: Lake Superior, fishing, hiking, adventure tours.
- [Northeastern Ontario](https://northernontario.travel/northeastern-ontario): Northeastern Ontario regional guide: The Seven, Killarney, road trips.
- [North Bay](https://northernontario.travel/north-bay): North Bay destination guide: Lake Nipissing, outdoor activities, festivals.
- [Sault Ste. Marie](https://northernontario.travel/sault-ste-marie): Sault Ste. Marie guide: Ojibwe culture, Agawa Canyon, Great Lakes.
- [Sudbury](https://northernontario.travel/sudbury): Sudbury destination guide: Science North, dining, eco-friendly travel.

## Seasonal Travel Planning

- [Plan Your Summer Trip](https://northernontario.travel/plan-your-summer-trip): Summer trip planning guide for Northern Ontario families and adventurers.
- [Plan Your Fall Trip](https://northernontario.travel/plan-your-fall-trip): Fall travel guide with foliage, regional activities, and seasonal planning.
- [Plan Your Winter Trip](https://northernontario.travel/plan-your-winter-trip): Winter activities guide: skiing, snowmobiling, ice fishing, climbing.

## Cultural & Heritage Experiences

- [Indigenous Experiences](https://northernontario.travel/indigenous): Indigenous cultural experiences, First Nations tourism, and pow-wows.
- [Canoe Culture](https://northernontario.travel/canoe-culture): Guide to canoe culture, paddling routes, and Indigenous voyageur heritage.
- [Group of Seven](https://northernontario.travel/group-of-seven): Group of Seven art history, Lake Superior landscape tourism guide.

## Activities & Experiences

- [Experience Fishing](https://northernontario.travel/experience-fishing): Experience Fishing program for beginners in Northwest Ontario.

## Travel Services

- [Places to Stay](https://northernontario.travel/stay): Accommodations directory: resorts, camping, glamping, fly-in lodges.
- [Where to Eat](https://northernontario.travel/where-to-eat): Dining guide featuring local cuisine, farm-to-table restaurants.

## About & Community

- [Northern Ontario Travel](https://northernontario.travel): Homepage introducing Northern Ontario's wilderness, cities, and scenic tours.
- [About](https://northernontario.travel/about): About page for Northern Ontario Travel site and Kate McCullough.
